title: One question
summary: Three buttons, a “choice” variable, and an “if … else” that checks the answer.
done: You know how the quiz checks an answer.

hello.text: Here is **The Big Quiz**! Answer the question in the preview, then let’s see how it knows if you are right.

click.text: When a button is tapped, we put its text in the **choice** variable. A variable is a box with a name.

check.text: The three buttons call the same function: the check is written only once.

test.text: [if … else]: if the choice is “8”, we write “Well done” in green; else, the right answer in red.

slow.text: Start **slow motion** to see the blocks light up.

watch.text: Tap an answer in the preview: watch the [if] light up, then only one of the two branches.
watch.hint: Tap an answer in the preview, or click “Restart”.

question.text: Change the question (in Design) and its right answer (in the [if]).
question.hint: For example: “How many wheels does a bike have?”, answers 1, 2, 3, and “2” in the [if].

toast.text: Also show a short message when it’s right.
toast.hint: The block is in the Interface category.
